name: compound-obstacle-continuity-evidence-v1
purpose: separate a recent seed42 obstacle-collision regression from the earlier seed11/17/21 post-obstacle hairpin unwind before changing the active controller

official_source.head: dfb7a2de2178825ca5c5ce20bab01ba67052ba31
official_source.finding: The official generator uses seed for geometry and track_id together with seed for obstacle placement. Seed42 is an installation example, not a published evaluation seed; seeds11/17/21 are also local official-generator inputs rather than published hidden evaluation seeds.

cross_seed_evidence.finding: Consumed seed11/17/21 runs left the road after an outside obstacle pass into a continuing hairpin. Final valid steering unwound to-0.027/+0.014/-0.012 even though the final valid speed was already29--30; collision was not the common terminal cause.
cross_seed_evidence.constraint: Any repair should preserve the pre-obstacle path and current-obstacle arbitration that previously completed seed42, while retaining same-direction steering only after a detected obstacle disappears into a continuing curve.

controller_audit: The current coherent gain is allowed on every obstacle-free coherent curve, including frames before any obstacle is detected and frames during an obstacle miss latch.
The current detector accepts compact bright components only in rows22--61 and the miss latch preserves side and speed target but does not itself replay the prior lateral obstacle bias.

Commit/run chronology separates two regressions: the FastCornerCarry route at02:23 preceded the02:26 finisher; the TranslationInvariantExit route at02:41 preceded the02:46 five-collision DNF; the CoherentCurveAttack route at03:18 preceded the03:20 four-collision/off-track DNF. The smallest evidenced recovery baseline is therefore FastCornerCarry, not TranslationInvariantExit.
binding_limitations: Run files contain map, policy name and telemetry but no source commit, agent hash, model hash or package hash. Commit/run chronology and action signatures make the regression plausible but not cryptographically causal.
All four seeds are consumed adaptive development evidence and cannot confirm a new candidate or support a SOTA claim.
Top-down replay frames do not expose the policy's four grayscale camera frames, detected obstacle tuple or controller state.
